verdict.rationale: Superpowers lets users author their own skills (writing-skills) that auto-trigger when the agent recognizes a matching situation, e.g. "Fix this bug" routes to systematic-debugging, and skills are invoked before any response. A session-start hook bootstraps this, and built-in safeguards such as architectural review after three failed fixes fire automatically. However, the triggers are LLM-judged task contexts rather than user-configurable event rules, and the automatic safeguards are fixed, not user-defined. missing for 10: user-definable event→action rules (explicit event types, conditions, actions), documented custom hook/trigger configuration beyond session start, independent corroboration of trigger reliability.
